title: His Mercy is More
lyrics_original: What love could remember no wrongs we have done?
Omniscient, all knowing, He counts not their sum.
Thrown into a sea without bottom or shore,
Our sins they are many, His mercy is more!
What patience would wait as we constantly roam?
What Father, so tender, is calling us home?
He welcomes the weakest, the vilest, the poor,
Our sins they are many, His mercy is more!
Praise the Lord! His mercy is more!
Stronger than darkness, new every morn,
Our sins they are many, His mercy is more!
What riches of kindness Christ lavished on us,
His blood was the payment, His life was the cost!
We stood 'neath a debt we could never afford,
Our sins they are many, His mercy is more!
Praise the Lord! His mercy is more!
Stronger than darkness, new every morn,
Our sins they are many, His mercy is more!
Praise the Lord! His mercy is more!
Stronger than darkness, new every morn,
Our sins they are many, His mercy is more!

bible_verses.english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor rewarded us iniquity for our wrongdoing. For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved).

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the incredible height and depth of Your mercy toward me. Forgive me for the times I doubt Your love or try to carry the burden of my own guilt. Help me to rest completely in the finished work of Jesus, knowing that Your grace is renewed for me every morning. Teach my heart to rejoice today because Your mercy is far greater than all my sin. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for the incredible height and depth of Your mercy toward me. devotional.reflection_english: It can be easy to let the weight of our past mistakes crowd out the joy of God’s love, but His grace is far grander than our deepest failures. In Christ, God does not keep a record of our wrongs; instead, He buries our sins in an ocean of infinite mercy. No matter how far we have wandered, our heavenly Father warmly invites us home into His loving embrace today. Let your heart rest in this breathtaking truth: though our sins are many, His mercy will always be more.
